verdict.rationale: Publishing processing times is a fair question for a commercial-register filing service, so the axis applies. The pack contains no published processing or turnaround times for any transaction type. The front-page overload notice about temporary unavailability of individual states' data is a portal-availability status, an adjacent feature that does not count as processing-time visibility.

support.subject: As a founder, current processing times for my transaction type are published by the service itself
